policy.hardware_verification: Per-feature physical fx-991ES PLUS key and LCD capture evidence is required; source-only tests do not establish hardware parity.
policy.other_labels: implemented means source functionality exists; approximation means partial educational behavior; unsupported means advertised exact function is absent or incomplete.
